description: Polyglot project script discovery and multi-service parallel runner.
pre_install: if (Get-Command python -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { $pyver = python -c "import sys; print(f'{sys.version_info.major}.{sys.version_info.minor}')"; if ([version]$pyver -lt [version]'3.11') { Write-Warning "devup requires Python 3.11+ (found $pyver)." } }
